title: mcp-ratchet audit log record
description: One JSON object per line in logs/<target_slug>-<session_id>.jsonl. schema_version appears on every record (not just a file header) so logs stay safely concatenable across a future version bump.

args_shape_hash.description: SHA-256 of canonicalized argument keys+types, NOT values (privacy default).

args_raw.description: Only populated when the proxy is run with --log-raw-args (explicit opt-in).

anomaly_flags.description: One call can trip multiple detectors at once.

whitespace_only_change.description: drift_event only. True when a field-level change (description_changed/other_changed) is identical to the baseline after whitespace normalization — e.g. a description that only gained a trailing space. Informational only: the exact-hash ratchet still fires on this change regardless of this flag; it exists so a human or the dashboard can deprioritize a purely cosmetic diff without the drift event itself ever being suppressed.
